To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the growth temperature of GaN on a MgAl2O _{4} (111) substrate by pulsed laser ablation has a significant impact on the structural properties of the GaN film.
The thickness of the interlayer between the substrate and the GaN film decreases with a decrease in the growth temperature and it is completely suppressed in RT growth.
the thickness of interfacial layer, crystal quality, and the diffusion of Mg decrease with decreasing growth temperatures.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the growth of Ga-face GaN films on (1 1 0) MgAl2O substrates using the PLD technique.
the structural properties of GaN films grown by PLD on MgAl22O4(11 11) substrates at various temperatures.
the growth of GaAs on GaAs substrates using the molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) method.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the growth of GaNs by PLD on MgAl22O4 substrated at RT is the best way for the fabrication of high quality GaN films with a high crystalline quality and a low density of defects.
the RT growth of GaNs on MgAl2 4(1  1  1) substrates is the best way to obtain high-quality GaN films with a low density of structural defects.
the RT growth is beneficial for the growth of GaNs on MgAl22O4 substrats by PLD.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the growth temperature dependence of the structural properties of GaN films is mainly related to the thickness of the GaN/MgAl2O(1 1)1 interfacial layer and the diffusion of Mg.
PLD is an efficient method to grow high-quality single crystalline Ga-face GaN films at low temperatures.
the growth of high-quality GaN films on (1 1 11) MgAl2O 4 substrates by the PLD technique can be achieved only when the growth temperature is as low as possible.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PLD is an ideal technique for growing single crystalline GaNs on MgAl2 O4 substrates at RT.
PLD is a powerful method for the growth of Ga-polar GaN on Mg-polar substrates.
the growth of Ga-N films at RT can effectively suppress the diffusion of the Mg atoms from the substrate to GaN films and improve the crystal quality of the Ga-N films.
